name: marathi-arc-c-2.5k
description: A Marathi-language version of the ARC Challenge (ARC-C) containing multiple-choice science questions. It measures scientific factual knowledge and reasoning ability in the Marathi language, targeting evaluation of multilingual and low-resource model performance.
reputation: Part of the Indic-Benchmark suite; moderately used to test multilingual and low-resource language capabilities of models.
